sentences.text: Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, and the learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Naved Ahmad seeks bail in Case Crime No.
0014 of 2023, under sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 34 I.P.C., P.S. Kotwali, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.I.R.) lodged on 04.01.2023 against 6 persons, including the applicant, stating that the co-accused Sangam Verma had introduced himself to the informant as Director of Lifelong Care Multi State Agro Co-operative Pvt. Ltd., which company provides plots of lands under the name and style STS Infra Built.

entities.text: Lifelong Care Multi State Agro Co-operative Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The FIR states that the applicant was working as a Director in the aforesaid Company.
The F.I.R. has been lodged when the informant did not get possession of the land from the Company.

entities.text: Mithlesh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and she has falsely been implicated in the present case.

The applicant's criminal history of 42 cases arising out of dealings of the aforesaid Company has been disclosed in para 12 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, in 5 of which the applicant has already been granted bail.

5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that even as per the FIR averments, the applicant was merely one of the directors of the said Company and out of 42 cases in which he has been implicated, the applicant has already been granted bail in 5 cases, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case also.
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
